entities.summary: Jaron Samuel Blossomgame is an American professional basketball player for AS Monaco of the French LNB Pro A and the EuroLeague. Blossomgame played college basketball for Clemson University and was selected in the second round of the 2017 NBA draft by the San Antonio Spurs.
